retained: Original real carrier, unit metric, whole-face incidence generators and fixed ownership
rate: V_kappa=sum_e kappa_e abs(2 alpha_f d_e x_f x_core), alpha_f>=0
accumulation: Integral on a specified actual common trajectory, or sum of actual discrete midpoint receipts for a specified event list
refinement_scope: Nonnegative coefficient partitions evaluated on the same state/path
weight_classification: Fixed, finite, nonnegative, sign-insensitive per-contact costs additive on positive magnitudes imply kappa_e abs(q); these are extra axioms and kappa remains free
bootstrap_limit: All instantaneous face/core currents vanish when all core amplitudes vanish
stock_limit: Gross circulation can grow without bound at constant conserved total support
candidate_reserve_law: R_next=R+imports-exports-gamma*gross_receipts; reserve, gamma, coupling and replenishment not supplied
open: Reserve/record carrier, outgoing contacts, reset and renewal
